NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Used to calculate the Qibla direction and prayer times for your location. The Qibla direction is calculated on your device; for prayer times your approximate location is sent to the Aladhan.com service and is not stored on our servers.
NSMotionUsageDescription: Motion sensors are used so the Qibla compass can show your phone's heading correctly. The data stays on your device.
